```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, dpi = 150, fig.align = "center",
                      out.width = "100%")
library(ggbasket)
library(ggplot2)
g <- as.data.frame(params$pbp)
home <- g$hometeam[1]; away <- g$awayteam[1]
nm <- params$names %||% stats::setNames(c(home, away), c(home, away))
nm <- c(nm, stats::setNames(setdiff(c(home, away), names(nm)), setdiff(c(home, away), names(nm))))
cols <- params$colours %||% ggbasket_colours$categorical[c(1, 2)]
cols <- stats::setNames(cols, c(home, away))
s <- game_summary(g)
league <- g$league[1]
cap <- ggbasket_caption(sprintf("%s, %s · %s play-by-play", league, params$date,
                                if (league == "NBA") "ESPN" else "EuroLeague live API"))
ct <- function(t) colour_text(nm[[t]], cols[[t]])
```

## Key findings

```{r findings, results = "asis"}
cat(paste0("- ", match_story(g, names = nm), collapse = "\n"))
```

## How the game unfolded

```{r flow, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5.4}
flow_title <- sprintf("%s %d-%d %s", nm[[home]], s$home_pts, s$away_pts, nm[[away]])
if (isTRUE(params$interactive)) {
  plot_game_flow_interactive(g, colours = unname(cols), min_run = 6, names = nm, title = flow_title,
                             subtitle = paste("Lead of", ct(home), "(up) or", ct(away), "(down); brackets = runs of 6+ unanswered points. Hover for the players on the floor; hover a bracket for why the run happened"),
                             caption = cap)
} else {
  plot_game_flow(g, colours = unname(cols), min_run = 6, title = flow_title,
                 subtitle = paste("Lead of", ct(home), "(up) or", ct(away), "(down); brackets = runs of 6+ unanswered points"),
                 caption = cap)
}
```

## Why the runs happened

```{r runs, results = "asis"}
er <- explain_runs(g, min_points = 6, names = nm)
if (nrow(er)) {
  cat(paste0("- ", er$story, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
} else cat("Neither team had a run of 6 or more unanswered points.\n")
```

<p class="note">Off turnovers / second-chance = the possession began with the opponent's turnover / included an offensive rebound. On the break = scored within 7 seconds of the turnover or defensive rebound. At the rim = a two from 8 feet or less. Players named on the bench are the opponent's three most-used players who sat most of the run.</p>

## The plays that decided it

```{r wp, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
wp <- win_probability(g)
plot_win_probability(wp, colours = unname(cols), title = "Win probability, play by play",
                     subtitle = paste("Chance that", ct(home), "(up) or", ct(away), "(down) wins, after every play."),
                     caption = cap)
```

## Why the result went the way it did

```{r factors, fig.width = 9.5, fig.height = 5}
gf <- game_factors(box_score(g, by = "team"))
plot_game_factors(gf, g$game_id[1], title = sprintf("What %s's win was made of", nm[[s$winner]]),
                  subtitle = "Each of the four factors' share of the margin, from a league model of how the factors turn into points",
                  caption = cap)
```

```{r vs-season, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6.2, eval = !is.null(params$season_pbp)}
sp <- as.data.frame(params$season_pbp)
ff <- four_factors(box_score(sp, by = "team"))
ff <- ff[ff$team %in% c(home, away), ]
ff$this <- ff$game_id == g$game_id[1]
vars <- c(`Shooting (eFG%)` = "efg", `Turnover rate` = "tov_pct", `Off. rebound rate` = "orb_pct",
          `Free-throw rate` = "ft_rate")
long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(vars), function(v) data.frame(var = v, value = ff[[vars[[v]]]], this = ff$this,
                                                                 team = nm[ff$team])))
long$var <- factor(long$var, levels = names(vars))
ggplot(long, aes(value, team)) +
  geom_point(data = long[!long$this, ], shape = 21, size = 2.6, fill = "grey80", colour = "white",
             position = position_jitter(height = 0.12, seed = 1)) +
  geom_point(data = long[long$this, ], aes(fill = team), shape = 21, size = 4, colour = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stats::setNames(unname(cols), nm[names(cols)]), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  facet_wrap(~var, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  theme_ggbasket(grid = "x") + theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "This game against each team's season so far",
       subtitle = "Grey = the team's other games this season; coloured = this game", caption = cap)
```

## Who mattered

```{r wpa, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6.5}
wpa <- win_probability_added(wp)
plot_wpa(wpa, colours = cols, title = "Win probability added",
         subtitle = "Each player's plays, plus a fifth of every opponent play while on the floor; players with 2+ points either way",
         caption = cap)
```

## Where the shots came from

```{r shots, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 5.8}
sh <- as_ggbasket_shots(g, league = league)
if (nrow(sh) > 0 && any(!is.na(sh$x))) {
  sh$team <- unname(nm[sh$team])
  plot_shot_density(sh, facet = "team", points = TRUE, league = league,
                    title = "Every shot of the game",
                    subtitle = "Heat = where each team shot from; dots = made, crosses = missed", caption = cap)
}
```

## Box scores

```{r box, results = "asis"}
bx <- game_score(box_score(g))
for (t in c(home, away)) {
  b <- bx[bx$team == t & bx$min > 0, ]
  b <- b[order(-b$min), ]
  tab <- data.frame(Player = b$player, MIN = round(b$min), PTS = b$pts,
                    `2P` = sprintf("%d/%d", b$p2m, b$p2a), `3P` = sprintf("%d/%d", b$p3m, b$p3a),
                    FT = sprintf("%d/%d", b$ftm, b$fta), REB = b$orb + b$drb, AST = b$ast, STL = b$stl,
                    BLK = b$blk, TOV = b$tov, `+/-` = b$pm, GmSc = round(b$game_score, 1), check.names = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("\n\n**%s**\n\n", nm[[t]]))
  print(knitr::kable(tab, format = "html", row.names = FALSE))
}
```

```{r explorer, eval = isTRUE(params$interactive)}
lineup_explorer(g, season_pbp = params$season_pbp, names = nm, colours = unname(cols))
```

## Clutch time and line-ups

```{r clutch, results = "asis"}
cl <- clutch_time(g)
if (nrow(cl)) {
  cb <- box_score(cl)
  cb <- cb[cb$pts > 0 | cb$tov > 0 | cb$ast > 0, ]
  cat("Last 5 minutes with the score within 5 points:\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(Team = unname(nm[cb$team]), Player = cb$player, PTS = cb$pts, AST = cb$ast,
                                TOV = cb$tov, `+/-` = cb$pm, check.names = FALSE), format = "html", row.names = FALSE))
} else cat("The game never reached clutch time (last 5 minutes within 5 points).\n\n")
lu <- lineups(g, min_minutes = 4)
if (nrow(lu)) {
  cat("\nFive-player units with 4+ minutes together:\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(Team = unname(nm[lu$team]), `Line-up` = gsub(" | ", ", ", lu$lineup, fixed = TRUE),
                                MIN = round(lu$min, 1), `Pts for` = lu$pts_for, `Pts against` = lu$pts_against,
                                check.names = FALSE), format = "html", row.names = FALSE))
}
```
